intro: Two global-shutter cameras, one rolling-shutter camera and a MEMS IMU, from Looper Robotics.

families.title: 3-cam + IMU
families.read_first: Kalibr's intrinsics and baselines are inputs from its own camera-only calibration; its td and lever are solved given them.
notes: Every tool uses the same IMU noise, measured at rest on this unit. Kalibr's td and lever are solved given its inputs. RS cam2 is MVIS only.
Kalibr's camera + IMU solver is global-shutter only, so the RS cam2 is not in its runs. Every tool uses the same IMU noise, measured at rest on this unit.
cam0 + cam1 (no rolling-shutter model, so no cam2).
